answer: A critic says a patient farm can fake any history. Not this one. Each identity carries a voyage of real jobs for unrelated principals, each signed by its principal. The network takes the pulse by spot-checking one past job; a lie ends the identity. One fake voyage costs one real job; a farm of a thousand pays for a thousand. A lagoon of parked accounts shows no pulse; an orchard bears fruit only from tended trees. Newcomers start empty and build one job at a time.
